_comment: How the next release should be announced by the in-app update check.
Lives with the code, not in a deploy-time flag, so it is reviewed in the
same commit as the change it describes and cannot be forgotten at ship time.
optional     nothing about how the tool works has changed. Say so, and
tell people they can ignore it.
recommended  worth having. The default, and what an unknown value falls
important    fixes something that stops the tool working. Never use this
for anything less — it is the only word left that means it.
summary: one plain sentence, shown under the version number.
summary: ClickGraft can now tell you which version of HP Click you actually need for your printer and your Mac, and hand you the download for it, instead of leaving that on the website. It can also make a copy of HP's own 4.11.31 that never updates itself, for anyone who wants to stay on a version they have tested. If your Mac is too old to make a copy at all, it now points you at 4.11.31 and says that version was checked on macOS 12 and opens. A copy made from an old HP Click no longer claims HP built it for Apple Silicon when you are on an Intel Mac, and a sentence that was being cut off mid-word now finishes.
